verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents routing Trigger and SLO burn alerts to custom webhooks that deliver JSON payloads to any service. Payloads can be customized with dynamic variables and Go template functions, so a receiving remediation service or agent gets structured alert context. Missing for 10: no documented example or guide for wiring webhooks into automated remediation or AI agents, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that this works in practice.
